english.title: Keep vehicle and trailer no rear registration plate - registered after 09/38
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), kept a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), with a trailer attached on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), when the registration mark assigned to the vehicle by the Secretary of State under section 23(1) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994 was not fixed to the rear of the trailer in the manner prescribed by Regulation 5 of the Road Vehicles (Display of Registration Marks) Regulations 2001
english.legislation: Contrary to section 42(1) and (2) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
kept vehicle with trailer attached registered on/after 1/10/1938 on a road
when the registration mark was not fixed to the rear of the trailer in the prescribed manner

english.notes:
(i) See Section 42(4) to (6) for defences
(ii) Regulation 5 applies to vehicles first registered on or after 1st October 1938.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - for wording see end of document.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant kept **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) with a trailer attached on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). There was no registration plate fixed to the rear of the trailer.
